title: Beethoven - Moonlight Sonata (FULL)
summary: A full piano performance of Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14, the Moonlight Sonata, with all three movements: Adagio sostenuto, Allegretto and Presto agitato.
why: Mostly cited as an example piece in audio and AI-music discussions, with one commenter urging people to hear the whole sonata, especially the third movement.

quote.text: anyone who's never heard the whole thing owes it to themselves to give it a listen.
